resolution: Fixed the actual cold-load loss and added an explicit GUI diagnostic. The v4 RJMD blob and decoder were healthy; the single-model resolveViewer branch reconstructed initialMesh with geometry/groups/materials but dropped semanticRegions, semanticInstances, and semanticTable. Both single- and multi-part mounts now cross one tested modelDocumentSeed boundary. Model Focus now renders a SEMANTICS section with mounted-vs-resident counts, region names/roles/face+instance counts, and RESIDENT/LOAD MISMATCH/LIVE ONLY/NO NAMES status. tools/seat semantic-status exposes that same diagnosis. ReleaseFast editor build and 17 focused V8 tests pass; user visual/cold-restart verification remains.
